description_en: Edits a Layer 7 HTTP flood mitigation rule
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo config-layer7-cc-rule --domain www.aliyun.com --name testCcRule1 --act close --count 2 --interval 5 --biz-mode match --ttl 60 --uri /a/b/c --api-version 2017-12-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ConfigLayer7CCRule

parameters.help_en: The domain name to operate on
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en: The name of the custom HTTP flood mitigation rule
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The action to take after the rule is triggered. Valid values:

close: Block.
captcha: CAPTCHA
parameters.help_zh:
规则触发后的操作，取值：

close：封禁
captcha：人机识别
parameters.name: act

parameters.help_en: The number of visits. This parameter is used together with Interval. When the same IP address consecutively visits the specified number of times within the interval specified by Interval, the rule is triggered. Valid values: 2 to 2000
parameters.help_zh: 访问次数，与Interval结合使用。当同一个IP在Interval指定的间隔时间内连续访问Count中指定的访问次数，则触发规则。取值范围为2~2,000。
parameters.name: count

parameters.help_en: The interval period, in seconds. This parameter is used together with Count. When the same IP address consecutively visits the number of times specified by Count within the interval specified by Interval, the rule is triggered. Valid values: 5 to 10800
parameters.help_zh: 间隔时间，与Count结合使用。当同一个IP在Interval指定的间隔时间内连续访问Count中指定的访问次数，则触发规则。取值范围为5~10,800。
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en:
The URI matching mode. Valid values:

match: exact match. The URI of the access request must be exactly the same as the specified Uri to be counted as a visit.
prefix: prefix match. The URI of the access request contains the specified Uri to be counted as a visit
parameters.help_zh:
URI匹配模式，取值：

match：完全匹配。访问请求的URI与指定的Uri完全相同，才计入访问次数。
prefix：前缀匹配。访问请求的URI包含指定的Uri，则计入访问次数
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en: The blocking duration if the action is set to block. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 60 to 86400
parameters.help_zh: 若规则触发后动作指定为封禁，设置封禁时间，单位为秒，取值范围为60~86,400
parameters.name: ttl
